summary: Wearable Devices Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, reporting a 1-for-3 reverse share split of its ordinary shares and warrants, approved by shareholders on June 4, 2026. The split consolidates every three shares into one, reducing outstanding from 6,568,408 to ~2,189,469 ordinary shares and warrants from 32,886 to ~10,962. No fractional shares issued; adjustments apply to options and exercise prices. Trading on Nasdaq begins split-adjusted June 22, 2026, under same symbols. This is a routine capital structure change aimed at regaining Nasdaq bid price compliance, not a special situation. No deal terms applicable.
